title: [finding] platform-readings: in a merge-queue repository the squash commit's committer date is the ENQUEUE instant, not the landing — `merged_at` and the `merged` event carry the fast-forward
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` execution PM seat, session `session_01HZfg2AwVX191qCizp88gQr`, at 2026-09-15T06:34Z, from the shift's third governed-merge audit (`check-governed-merges.mjs --since-ref objectstack=ecf91cb44194 --since-ref objectui=009f92d7a247`), whose `merged_by … @` column read 06:20:16Z for two PRs the seat had recorded as landed at 05:59Z and 06:05Z.

## The reading (measured on the eight PRs this seat landed today)

| PR | `added_to_merge_queue` | squash commit committer date (`git log -1 --format=%ci`) | `merged` timeline event = `merged_at` |
|---|---|---|---|
| #18270 → `48a93fb6` | 05:59:17Z | 05:59:17 | 06:20:16Z |
| #18242 → `1a02ef17` | 06:05:42Z | 06:05:42 | 06:20:16Z |
| #18243 → `ecf91cb4` | — | 03:18:12 | 03:44:22Z |
| #18251 → `fd124714` | — | 04:25:59 | 04:51:42Z |
| #18255 → `47bfcd09` | — | 04:54:26 | 05:15:32Z |
| #18257 → `e592b4b6` | — | 04:57:38 | 05:18:31Z |
| #18259 → `c053f748` | — | 05:32:58 | 05:48:11Z |
| #18266 → `e9091487` | — | 05:45:08 | 06:02:51Z |

- Where the enqueue instant was read (the first two rows) it equals the committer date to the second. The queue writes the squash commit onto `refs/gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-N-<base>` at enqueue; when the group's checks pass, `main` is fast-forwarded to that object, so no later commit exists and the date never moves.
- `merged_at`, the `merged` timeline event and `removed_from_merge_queue` all carry the fast-forward instant. #18270 and #18242 read the same `merged_at` — one group, one fast-forward.
- The gap today is 15 to 26 minutes, i.e. the queue's dwell time.

## Consequence (owned by the seat)

A landing instant read from `git log`, or from the audit's `commit … @` column, is early by the dwell time. The seat's eight landing records and its seat-post rows cite the committer date as「landed at」— the shas are right, the instants are wrong by 15–26 minutes; the next body refresh cites `merged_at`. The audit script already prints both columns and needs no change.
